model_source.scope: Historical R3 exact model, also present in E1; no prior E2 live generation configuration. E2 adoption is registered now.

api_mode: MiniMax hosted OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions REST v1; not OpenAI provider
library: CPython 3.14.7 stdlib json/urllib.request; no model SDK; P1 builds plain request objects only
unsupported_scope: Not exposed/guaranteed by the reviewed M2.7 REST profile; do not send or emulate. This is not a claim about all MiniMax endpoints. No provider-side JSON guarantee.
thinking: M2.x always on; disabling/control NOT_SUPPORTED; reasoning_split changes response representation only
tool_call_mode: One JSON runtime action in message.content; no native function tools, no parallel calls
structured_output_mode: Prompt-directed JSON; strict local action schema; no repair

context.overflow: Terminate CONTEXT_LIMIT before dispatch; never truncate, summarize or drop source evidence
context.token_counting: No exact local MiniMax tokenizer; UTF8 size is an operational guard, not proof of provider token fit; provider context rejection follows provider failure policy
context.assembly: One system message = common.txt + role template + canonical action schema + family tool/output profile. One user message = canonical typed released context snapshot. No developer message, chat transcript or hidden reasoning reinjection. Each request is a fresh snapshot invocation.

response_handling: Require exactly one choice, stop finish reason and nonempty string message.content. Separate reasoning fields are private audit only; never parsed as actions or published to other principals. Tool calls in response are protocol failure. No think-tag stripping or markdown extraction.

accounting.credentials: Existing MINIMAX_API_KEY resolved outside Git only at separately authorized execution; no environment override of model or endpoint
accounting.billing_project: Existing credential account; account/project ID not required by this API; no X-Group-Id header
accounting.tokens: Retain returned usage fields verbatim in private audit; safe numeric counters only; missing usage is UNKNOWN. Reserve 8192 generated-token slots per invocation so 24 calls cannot exceed 196608 requested tokens. Record provider accounting discrepancies.
accounting.latency: time.perf_counter_ns around request and episode, including wait and parsing; UTC timestamps for audit
accounting.cost: NOT_REPORTED; no frozen tariff or currency conversion; raw usage only; cost never controls continuation
